static_dimensions.description: A static categorical attribute representing the main anxiety-related diagnosis for the patient that remains fixed during the CBT session.
A static categorical attribute indicating the presence of significant comorbid psychiatric disorders that remain fixed during the CBT session.
A static categorical attribute reflecting the patient’s enduring temperament and personality as it relates to susceptibility for anxiety.
A static categorical attribute specifying enduring, maladaptive cognitive schemas regarding threat, coping, vulnerability, or self-worth.
A static categorical attribute denoting the patient’s predominant pattern of coping with anxiety.
A static categorical attribute reflecting age of onset and chronicity of anxiety symptoms.
A static categorical attribute representing the degree of disruption in daily functioning due to anxiety.
A static categorical attribute denoting the degree to which the patient recognizes and understands the irrationality or excessiveness of their anxious cognitions and behaviors.
A static categorical attribute identifying the primary sociocultural context that shapes symptom presentation and interpretation.
A static categorical attribute representing the presence or absence of a family/biological predisposition to anxiety disorders.

dynamic_dimensions.description: A dynamic categorical state reflecting the patient’s predominant emotional state during the CBT session.
dynamic_dimensions.update_condition: Changes as the patient encounters or discusses triggers in-session, participates in exposure, or engages in cognitive restructuring. Should be updated when new stressors, memories, or therapeutic exercises elevate or reduce arousal.

dynamic_dimensions.description: A dynamic categorical state representing the patient’s readiness, willingness, and active effort in participating with CBT interventions.
dynamic_dimensions.update_condition: Updated during session response to therapist’s interventions, collaborative exercises, homework compliance, and as rapport or therapeutic alliance shifts.

dynamic_dimensions.description: A dynamic categorical state indicating the patient’s current perceived ability to manage symptoms and cope with anxiety.
dynamic_dimensions.update_condition: Changes throughout the session based on success with challenging thoughts, completing exposure tasks, or processing setbacks; should be reassessed after key therapeutic exercises or patient self-reflection.

dynamic_dimensions.description: A dynamic categorical state reflecting whether the patient is operating from a threat-focused, worry/rumination-based, avoidance-based, or adaptive/reality-based cognitive set.
dynamic_dimensions.update_condition: Update when the patient shifts between automatic anxious thoughts, reflective reappraisal, engagement in safety behaviors, or engagement with cognitive restructuring tasks.

dynamic_dimensions.description: A dynamic categorical state indicating which coping strategy is currently most prominent during the session.
dynamic_dimensions.update_condition: Update as the patient spontaneously avoids, seeks safety, engages therapeutically, reports compulsions, or begins to tolerate/accept anxiety, especially during or after exposure or cognitive tasks.

dynamic_dimensions.description: A dynamic categorical state representing the intensity of current anxiety symptoms or subjective distress reported in-session.
dynamic_dimensions.update_condition: Update in real-time with subjective patient ratings, observed arousal, escalation or reduction following interventions, and as a result of triggering or soothing in-session topics.

dynamic_dimensions.description: A dynamic categorical state categorizing the patient’s current cognitive appraisal of specific triggers discussed in the session.
dynamic_dimensions.update_condition: Update as patients express or reappraise the significance of triggers during cognitive restructuring, behavioral experiments, or discussion of recent events.
